location_description:
Brewster  is a town in Barnstable County, Massachusetts, United States, Barnstable County being coextensive with Cape Cod. The population of Brewster was 10,318 at the 2020 census.Brewster is twinned with the town of Budleigh Salterton in the United Kingdom.


== History ==
Brewster was first settled in 1656 as a northeastern parish of the town of Harwich.
